_readme: The radar's work list. One entry per query this project wants to own.
It runs on a schedule, takes the open entry that has gone longest without
being looked at, finds what currently ranks for it, and briefs something
Add a target when a query's current top results are weak in a way this
project can specifically beat. Do not add one because it has volume. A page
written because the keyword was available is the thing a quality floor
status: 'open' is in rotation. 'done' has an article. 'rejected' means we
looked and the incumbents were good enough, which is a real outcome worth
recording so the radar does not suggest it again.

targets.query: replace me with a real query
targets.gap: What you think the pages currently ranking for this get wrong. A hunch is fine; the radar is allowed to disagree and reject it.
